based_on_test: RC4.1 physical test logs of 2026-10-03 over Wi-Fi 7 (client and host reports, SteamVR logs) and the user's requests for the pages, reports, Game Mode and the in-headset pop-up
scope: Even pose timing: tracking samples on a grid locked to the local display (N per refresh, spacing <= 3.5 ms, four at 75/90 Hz), re-anchored to vsync each second, half-spacing shift when the host pick point sits on a sample (>5 % slot changes in 150 picks, 3 s hold-off, at most 8 shifts); RC4.1 used a free-running 4 ms timer

Frame re-aim: rotation-only homography per eye (core/reaim.hpp), compute shader with 9-tap Catmull-Rom (reaim.comp), submitted with the WaitGetPoses pose; own command pool on the render thread; up to 4 output images reused after compositor retirement; tri-state submit (-1 fall back, 0 not accepted, 1 accepted)
Alignment check: 10 s, every other second labelled with a pose yawed 3 degrees; the answer switches re-aim

Access-point lock for Wi-Fi sessions: 802-11-wireless.bssid via nmcli connection modify --temporary (a saved change only when nmcli rejects --temporary, never after a timeout), reconnect once, cleared with a saved change (temporary if the profile cannot be saved), receipt deleted only when the lock is known gone, no new lock over a leftover one, undo on failed/timed-out change; skipped for a known single AP with good signal and personal security, Wi-Fi 7 MLO or an existing BSSID; empty or stale AP lists count as unknown
Wi-Fi/Ethernet detection (band, signal, link rate; Ethernet speed, duplex, USB adapter, EEE note)
In-headset SteamVR-style cards (stb_truetype, Inter/Outfit, logo) and quality pill; RC4 bitmap panel fallback

Game Mode: --prefer-output ranks connected headsets (EDID) and empty remembered headset ports last, monitors on former headset ports keep their place; wrapper exceptions and a removed executable run plain gamescope; redrawn SDL screen via libvrosttext.so at native resolution
Steam library entry: shortcuts.vdf binary KeyValues byte-exact round trip, backup, receipt, artwork (cover, capsule, hero, logo, icon, logo position), Steam closed/started with its own environment

Reports: report_info and versioned names; report-upload feature and /report action (6 MiB body, 16 MiB decoded, credentials in headers checked before the body is read, one body at a time, zlib/EOF errors refused cleanly, start network policy, stored as received under host-numbered names, 20 files / 96 MB); background send that never holds the action lock; [GRAPH] lines dropped from the host driver log
Reprojection check: a repair marker replaces the settings-file time comparison
Native client and runtime probe rebuilt (RC4.1 shipped both labelled rc4); packaging refuses stale labels
Companion-only host repack over the RC4.1 payload; stale companion files pruned (Game Mode font atlas)
toolchain: Ubuntu 24.04, GCC 13.3.0, CMake, glslangValidator 15.1.0, Mesa lavapipe 25.2.8 (shader tests), PyInstaller 6.22.3 on Python 3.12.3, NSIS 3.09, fontTools and Pillow (build-time assets only)

tests.native: 17/17 CTest suites, including reaim_contracts, reaim_shader_contracts (lavapipe), tracking_schedule_contracts and status_card_contracts (rendered cards inspected)
tests.desktop_ui: pass (connection kind, Wi-Fi options only on Wi-Fi, Steam add/remove, re-aim and alignment check, background report delivery, received reports, collapsible diagnostics, bundled fonts)
tests.transport_smoke: not rerun: transport library unchanged since RC4

package_checks: client ZIP CRC and payload SHA256SUMS; managed RC4.2 install over an RC4.1 install keeps settings and adds the RC4.2 defaults (stay_on_access_point, reaim); old version folder removed; desktop entries (Game Mode entry named VROSTBridge)
installed self-test (1641 packaged files verified); native client and probe labels 1.0.0-rc4.2; ldd of the native client and libvrosttext.so resolve; libvrosttext exports only vrosttext_* symbols
installed companion: status, page, fonts, Steam artwork, stamped report, send-report returns at once and reports its outcome, quit
same-version repair, damaged-package refusal with the installation unchanged, uninstall keeps state
installed Game Mode screen rendered offscreen from the frozen package

host payload: verified RC4.1 payload + RC4.2 companion, docs, fonts and licences; driver byte-identical to RC4.1; stale Game Mode font atlas removed; setup EXE built with NSIS 3.09 and its extracted payload re-verified against SHA256SUMS
independent_review: A separate review agent checked the RC4.2 changes; its ten findings (received report storage size, Steam inheriting the frozen library path, a command pool shared across threads, headset ranking of former headset ports, Wi-Fi lock receipt and timeout handling, empty access-point lists, zlib errors on /report, an upload holding up Stop, double submission without focus, gamescope wrapper failure paths) were fixed with tests. A second review of the fixes found three more (a timed-out temporary lock retried as a saved one and then cleared only in memory, client report names with a suffix escaping pruning, a 6 MiB report body parsed before authentication), fixed with tests.
remaining_validation: All RC4.2 behaviour on hardware (see RELEASE_1.0.0-rc4.2.md, How to test)
RC4.1 and RC4 physical checks: dropout recovery, encoder backlog, foveation on Index and Beyond 2e, gaze path, AV1, wake/sleep, quick resume
Earlier physical gates: Beyond projection result, Game Mode lease, timing lock
